import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('don_hang.csv')
ct = pd.read_csv('chi_tiet_don.csv')

# June 2026 orders, not cancelled/returned
june = df[(df['Ngày'] >= '2026-06-01') & (df['Ngày'] <= '2026-06-30')]
qual = june[june['Tình trạng'].isin(['completed','shipping'])].copy()

order_ids = set(qual['Mã chứng từ'])
rev = ct[ct['Mã đơn hàng'].isin(order_ids)]['Amount'].sum()
n_orders = len(qual)
avg = rev / n_orders

print("qualifying orders:", n_orders)
print("total revenue:", rev)
print("avg revenue per order:", avg)
